THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, hereby declare, under Sub-section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land describedbelow is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

An allotment of land called Dodamgashinnawatte in extent of0.0633 Hectare, depicted in Advance Tracing No. Maha/PJP/ 2014/612 and dated 05.12.2014, prepared by the Surveyor-General,situated in the Village of Galhinna in the Minor Division ofPallegampaha Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division ofPoojapitiya in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded asfollows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Dodamgashinnawatte – Extent: About0.0633 HectareNorth: Dodamgashinnawatte claimed by K. B. Ekanayaka; East:Dodamgashinnawatte claimed by K. B. Ekanayaka andDodamgashinnawatte claimed by Muhammad Hussain Fausul Naima;South: Dodamgashinnawatte claimed by Muhammad Hussain FausulNaima and Road (P.S.); West: Road (P.S.), Dodamgashinnawatteclaimed by State and Dodamgashinnawatte claimed by K. B.Ekanayaka.
M. K. A. D. S. Gunawardana,Minister of Lands.
Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2014/WS/138.Ministry of Lands,‘Mihikatha Medura’,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.04th June, 2015.
